Lead source: inbound - self-serve signup (trial credits used). SMB legaltech focused on mid-market law firms; product = contract review + search assistant for attorney teams.

Quick summary: Rightscribe signed up on 2026-02-20, ran quickstart with hosted API. Wants low-friction self-serve but has an internal security checklist. Primary ask: strong audit logging + per-request metadata for e-discovery trails. Prefers US-only region (data residency).

CRM timeline (short bullets):
- 2026-02-20: self-serve signup, redeemed credits, created API key, initial test calls to embeddings and chat.
- 2026-02-24: discovery call (30m) w/ Jordan Kim + Priya Desai (SE). Notes: "We have confidential client docs—audit trail and retention are mandatory."
- 2026-02-26: sent hosted API quickstart + sample policy for retention; Drive links attached.
- 2026-03-02: technical follow-up email about encryption at rest / KMS; they requested examples of audit logs and exported JSON schema. (see gmail thread id).
- 2026-03-04: SE call scheduled to deep-dive on audit_logging + delivery SLA; blocked until internal security sign-off.

Use-case details / requirements (from calls):
- Workloads: embeddings for document search (primary), chat summarization (attorney assistant), contract clause reranking for precedence matching.
- Latency: conversational chat target ~150-300ms p50 for short responses; embeddings queries okay at 100-200ms. Throughput small (tens req/sec peak).
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget conscious; prefer pay-as-you-go hosted with predictable per-token estimate.
- Models: open to Redwood-curated smaller models + fallbacks; want an easy path to quantized variants for cost.
- Routing/fallback: prefer fallback to cheaper model if region capacity limited; want explicit policy controls.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must satisfy SOC2-type assurances; asked if Redwood provides SOC2 report (requested copy).
- Critical: detailed audit logging (per-request user id, API key, timestamp, model variant, token counts).
- Data residency: US only.
- Encryption: need KMS-managed keys / proof of encryption at rest.
- Retention: retention controls to purge logs after 90/365 days per client configs.

Quotes / paraphrases:
- "We need an immutable trail for e-discovery—every API call should be auditable."
- "Self-serve is great, but security has to green-light it before procurement."

POC / next milestones:
- Provide sample audit log export (JSON) + SOC2 pointer by 2026-03-08.
- SE deep-dive (30m) to review per-request metadata and KMS options (scheduled).
- If security clears, propose 3-month pilot (hosted API) using reduced-cost tier.

Suggested sales notes / tips:
- Emphasize hosted API speed-to-value and self-serve onboarding; highlight US-region hosting and audit log capabilities.
- Offer limited dev credits and sample log schemas to unblock security review quickly.
- Keep messaging tight on predictable pricing and fallback policies for cost control.
